name: quick
description: About 1 h simulated on the small OT plant: 20 min of normal traffic to learn, 15 min with three OT intrusions injected at fixed offsets, then 25 min of asset and conversation changes. Seconds with --clock synthetic, about 2 min on the wire with --speed 30.

stages.description: normal operation for the monitor to learn
ICS reconnaissance + C2, a PLC STOP from the engineering workstation, SMB lateral movement and unauthorized Modbus writes
a new PLC is commissioned, two new conversations (one cell to cell), an HMI goes offline

phases.name: new-plc
phases.description: a CompactLogix joins the Rockwell cell and its HMI starts polling it

phases.name: new-conversations
phases.description: SCADA starts polling PLC-RW2; PLC-RW1 talks S7 to the Siemens cell
